Companion Animal Travel Desk guidance

This section sets out how we keep companion travel safe, steady, and humane for every booking. Our team should speak in clear, calm language, check paperwork with care, and treat every animal as a shared responsibility from first contact to handoff.

When a traveler reaches out, the desk should confirm that the booking details match the animal, crate, and route information on file. Staff should review fit, condition, and comfort before acceptance, and they should never rush a check when an animal seems unsettled. Handlers should use gentle movements, soft voices, and patient pauses, because calm support makes the process easier for the traveler and the pet. The desk should also remind travelers to arrive prepared with the needed documents, secure carriers, and any approved comfort items.

For larger animals, the team must be especially careful with age, strength, and handling needs, and the booking should not move forward unless the required travel conditions are met. <<FACT F075>> For rabbits and other small pets, staff should verify crate readiness, ventilation, and safe placement before loading. <<FACT F064>> If anything seems unclear, incomplete, or inconsistent, the desk should stop the process and ask for a review before the animal is accepted.

Aurelia Skyways expects the Companion Animal Travel Desk to keep records accurate, manners warm, and decisions consistent, so every journey starts with trust and ends with a smooth arrival. If you need support, contact the senior coordinator or the operations desk right away.
